title: Follow-ups
notes: Rebuilt on ListPage: FilterBar+infinite scroll+skeleton come from the archetype, hover row actions (complete/reschedule/cancel), bulk cancel, full-dataset CSV export. PUT /follow-ups/:id (reschedule) and DELETE /follow-ups/:id (cancel) are now wired via dialogs. No detail drawer (no per-follow-up detail view in scope) and no urlPrefill/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/sendMessageDialog — not applicable to this entity's fields.
showcaseScript: Open Follow-ups and filter to overdue
Complete a follow-up and log the outcome
Reschedule another follow-up to next week
